Definition: adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5401; fearlessly:--without fear.
BiblicalUsage: Without fear — serving God in holiness and righteousness without fear, Timothy working without fear among the Corinthians, the brethren waxing confident to speak the word without fear, and the false shepherds feeding themselves without fear. The same word praises the fearless and exposes them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fearlessness is good only when it serves God: Timothy's quiet courage and the false teachers' bold self-feeding wear the same word, and the difference is whom they serve. I hold that my own fearlessness is worth having only if it is spent on speaking his word.
